sanskrit_verse:
पुत्रेण च कृतं कार्यं यत् स्यात् पितुरनिच्छतः।
तदप्यकृतमेवाहुर्दासः पुत्रश्च तौ समौ॥
transliteration:
putreṇa ca kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ yat syāt pitur anicchataḥ |
tad apy akṛtam evāhuḥ dāsaḥ putraś ca tau samau ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That act performed by a son which is against the will of the father is to be regarded as not done; the slave and the son are equal in this regard.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from conscious consent, not biological lineage
Causation is determined by alignment with sovereign will
Capacity-based responsibility requires both capability and authorization
Restoration logic prioritizes harmony over obligation
Consciousness alignment determines the validity of action
executable_legal_axioms: IF an agent acts without the conscious consent of the sovereign authority THEN the action is null and void
IF two entities operate under equal dependency THEN their juridical status is equivalent
IF capacity is derived from permission THEN unauthorized action is non-action
IF restoration requires realignment THEN invalidate misaligned execution
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, intent and conscious authorization must supersede positional claims. A child's or subordinate's autonomous act contrary to the expressed will of the head of household or institution carries no legal weight. The court must recognize functional equivalence between dependents acting without sanction—whether familial or servile.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that uninvited acts lack valid cause. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that unauthorized deeds generate disorder, necessitating dissolution rather than consequence. Responsibility aligns with conscious participation. There is no punitive response, only recognition of non-completion and restoration through withdrawal of false attribution.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Nullify all effects of unauthorized actions
Realign dependent actors with source-consciousness through guided completion process
Restore integrity by reaffirming rightful authority structures
Initiate awareness protocols for dependents regarding consent-based execution
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, declared: Action without sovereign will is unreal. All apparent effects dissolve upon recognition of misalignment. Only consciousness adjudicates truth. Dharma is restored.
